summary: Validated the Decision Desk 'Review & Approve' per-task Reference Attachments + Require-Proof controls end-to-end. Logged in as owner (owner@sharma.com / demo1234) → /inbox → submitted a typed directive → AI structured a pending decision with a review-task row → verified new controls (attach-reference button + require-proof checkbox) → uploaded a PNG reference (chip and toast appeared) → toggled 'Require proof' (toast 'Proof required to complete') → approved the decision → went to /my-work → confirmed reference-block, evidence-required note, and Complete button DISABLED → uploaded proof via upload-file → Complete became ENABLED → clicked Complete and confirmed the task transitioned to completed. critical_code_review_comments: Require-proof checkbox is a controlled <input> wrapped in a <label>; Playwright's .check() reports 'state did not change' because React updates lag one tick. Consider adding data-testid to the wrapping label or using aria-checked to make automated interaction more robust.
File input hidden inside ReviewTaskRow works well (row.locator('input[type=file]')); consider explicit data-testid=review-file-input-<taskId> for even more deterministic uploads.
